args.body: The host reports products/distribution/sqlite-curated-tools/operator-listing-draft.json has committed. Read it and the original evidence cited in it. Under your valid SQLITE-CURATED-TOOLS-PLACEMENT lease, decide whether the exact listing is ready for operator handoff. Check the closest merged listing's changed lines, any applicable contribution policy, the existing free release URL and inquiry identifier, and the proposed AI and author-affiliation disclosure. Policy silence leaves permission unresolved. If ready, preserve the exact unsent submission and its account prerequisite. Otherwise record the decisive gap and the evidence that would reopen it. Read back the saved outcome and close with a lesson. Keep submission, listing acceptance, attributable inquiries and settlement distinct. No external submission.
